notes.title: Update Notice for SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays on STEAM®
notes.content:
▼STEAM Update Available on:
Wednesday November 18th, 2020

▼Update Overview
A bug has been fixed that affected machines running Windows 10 versions 2004 (May 2020 Update) and 20H2 (October 2020 Update) and would cause the game to crash when attempting to set a folder in the BGM Edit screen.

We apologize for taking so long to address this issue, and are sorry for any inconvenience it has caused.

notes.title: Ver. 1.60 Update Patch
notes.content:
▼ STEAM version update launch date
5/28/2020 (Thu.)

■ Made compatible with new, paid-for DLC “Expansion Pack.”

■ Added “Limit Break” function
• Added a “Limit Break” function to the character level up screen.
All of the following are expanded when Limit Break is used on a character.
[list][*] Can level up beyond level 100.	
[*] Can level up to “former value +999” with status level up with capital.
[*] Can also level up status by using limit break points.
[*] Some characters can use limit break points to add ability equipment slots.[/list]

• Added “Limit Break” function to the unit enhance screen.
All of the following are expanded when Limit Break is used on a unit.
[list][*] Can level up beyond level 100.
[*] Maximum status values increase when enhance points are allocated to them.
[*] Option part equipment slots added.[/list]

*Capital is necessary for “Limit Break.”
*You can receive a certain amount of limit break points for a character by “enacting limit break” or “leveling up above level 100.”

■ Expanded player character functions
[list][*] You can now select the “uniform” and “pilot suit” outfits.
[*] Added one type of outfit pattern to male and female outfits (new outfits cannot be set with no face shadow).
[*] Added a “helmet on/off” toggle function to some outfits.
[*] Added new selectable voices.[/list]

■ Expanded config functions
[list][*] Added a “undeployed units only” search to the unit search in the “controls “ tab.
[*] Added a function to apply BGM settings to guest characters and enemy characters in the “sound” tab.[/list]
――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

■ Notification about paid DLC “expansion pack”
These are the main adjustments made in the “Inferno” difficulty added in the expansion pack.
We respectfully ask for your understanding in these adjustments.
[list]
[*] Some enemies appear with special character abilities.
[*] Some enemies appear with special option parts equipped.
[*] Some enemies appear in an excited state.
[*] Cannot use HP recovery-type MAP weapons.
[*] Group area and command area of Leadership adjusted.
[*] Adjusted damage of battleship and attack alignments.
[*] Adjusted critical activation chance of battleship and attack alignments.
[*] Adjusted EXP gained from battleship and attack alignments.
[*] Adjusted damage of support attacks based on number of people participating.
[*] Adjusted POW and range correction of the weapon effect “Awakening.”
[*] Limited MP increase from the unit ability “Knight of Light.”
[*] Limited the damage reduction accuracy, and dodge correction to the unit ability “Golden Guardragon.”
[*] Adjusted the effect of the unit ability “Mobile Trace System.”
[*] Slightly adjusted the effect of the character ability “Adversity.”
[*] Adjusted the effect of the character ability “Overpower.”
[*] Set a limit to the amount of HP and EN recovery for the character ability “Will of the Golden Dragon.”
[*] Set a limit to the amount of HP and EN recovery for the character ability “Spirit of the Algus Knights.”
[/list]

■ Notification about update Ver. 1.60
With the level maximum unlocked, when a unit or character’s level gets above 100,
gaining experience in the existing (Normal, Hard, Extra, Hell) difficulties is more difficult. This is intentional.
Again, we kindly ask for your understanding.

The paid DLC “expansion pack” will be available starting on 5/28/2020 (Thu.).

*The paid DLC “expansion pack” is content separate from and not a part of the “season pass” being sold.
Please be aware of this when making your purchase.

notes.title: 【Urgent Updates】Updates on bug reports found
notes.content:
This is a following up update dated 29 November 2019 regarding game crash abnormality reported during gameplay.

Despite ongoing investigation to determine the cause, the workaround solutions listed below may help to overcome the issues. Please kindly consider these solutions should you encounter any of the reported issues. We would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――
■Instructions■

①DisplayPort (DP) for PC/External monitor display output from PC laptop
『SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays』 unable to run properly when booting up with main display using onboard graphics may be due to not meeting the minimum specification required.

In the event of black screen transition after booting up, please follow the steps listed below to determine if the main display is using the onboard graphics.

・For Windows 10
1. Right-click on Windows desktop and select “Display settings” from the popup window.
2. For multiple monitor display, please ensure that the right monitor is selected before checking the box “Make this my main display”.
　 For single monitor, the monitor display number is 1.
3. Click on “Advanced display settings”.
4. Select the monitor display number assigned as main display.
5. Click “Display adapter properties for Display (number)” to see the display information.
6. Verify the adaptor type and onboard graphics via the properties in ”Adaptor” tab.
　 (For onboard graphics, you should be able to see Intel(R) HD Graphics 630)

Please refer to the following steps if main display is using onboard graphics.

・Mulitple Monitor display
　Assign the GPU meeting the minimum specification or higher as main display and verify if issue persist.

・Single Monitor display
　Assign the GPU meeting the minimum specification or higher as display output and verify if issue persist.


②Workaround PC Laptop without dedicated GPU
・For Windows 10
　1.Select ”Settings”→”System”→”Display”（Alternatively right-click on Windows desktop and select “Display settings”）.
　2.Click “Graphics settings”.
　3.Under “Graphics performance preference”, select “Classic app”.
　4.Click “Browse” button and select TOGG.exe from the install directory.
　5.Select 『SD GUNDAM G GENERATION CROSS RAYS』 options.
　6.Select “High performance” and save the settings.
　※Windows Update may be required.
――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

In the event if the above workaround does not work, please wait for our subsequent updates from the ongoing investigation.

Once again, we deeply regret all the inconvenience caused and would like to seek your kind understanding and support.

notes.title: [Important announcement] Irregularities reported
notes.content:
[b]■ [Important announcement] Irregularities reported in SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays STEAM® version.[/b]

We would like to address the irregularities reported occurring in SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays STEAM® version on [PST] 27th November 2019, 3:00 pm / [CET] 28th November 2019, 12:00 am.
Currently, the bugs have been fixed with an update patch. Please restart the STEAM® Client for the update.

[b]■ Irregularity occurrence[/b]
[list][*] Time of occurrence
[PST] 27th November 2019, 3:00 pm-5:40 pm
[CET] 28th November 2019, 12:00 am-2:40 pm
[*] In the STEAM version, the following irregularities are confirmed and fixed. 
- Damage value is not reflected properly. Abnormal damage value is shown.
- Game crashes when viewing profiles. 
- Configuration settings are not reflected correctly. 
- Other improvements in operational stability.
[/list]

[b]■ Solution[/b]

An update patch was released at on [PST] 27th November 2019, 5:40 pm / [CET] 28th November 2019, 2:40 am to prevent the irregularities mentioned above from occurring.
In the case of irregularity occurrence mentioned above, please restart the STEAM Client to apply the update patch.

We would like to sincerely apologize to all the players for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your continued support in SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays.
